summary: Armour Residential REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to announce a routine monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share for August 2026, with record and payment dates of August 17 and August 28, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 that reiterates the dividend information and standard REIT tax-distribution language. There are no terms or actions consistent with a special situation—no M&A, capital return beyond ordinary dividend, restructuring, or governance event. The filing is a standard periodic dividend declaration for a REIT.
